candidate_windows.window_text:
In this section, we describe our experiments and results. For prompting the proprietary LLMs, we use their APIs, namely OpenAI² and Anthropic³. For the open-source models, we obtain model checkpoints from the Huggingface⁴ model hub. We perform inference with the LLMs using llama.cpp⁵ with the default sampling strategy. The experiments with open-sourced models are conducted on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU with 48GB VRAM.

For our analysis, we consider the exam-level and question-level grades. An exam-level grade is the sum of the grades of all questions in the exam.
